name: My life is now a fanfiction?!
source:
How many romance tropes can we fit into the story? An anti-romantic main character ends up having their life magically shifted toward love.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]

我们可以在这个故事中融入多少浪漫的比喻？一个反浪漫的主角最终让他们的生活神奇地转向爱情。

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
